description.zh: 你现在正在看的这个博客。纯静态 HTML/CSS/JS 构建，Markdown 撰写，一键中英切换，深浅色主题。
description.en: The blog you're reading right now. Built with pure static HTML/CSS/JS, Markdown-powered, one-click bilingual switch, light/dark themes.

description.zh: 面向大学生的轻量记账工具，支持多账户管理、预算控制、月度统计和数据导出。Node.js + Express 后端，SQLite 数据库，原生 JS 前端。
description.en: A lightweight bookkeeping tool for college students. Multi-account management, budget control, monthly statistics, CSV export. Node.js + Express backend, SQLite, vanilla JS frontend.
